allow_instructions: Always allow npm, npx, node, and TypeScript build commands in this workspace.
Always allow git status, git diff, git add, git commit, git push, and git log for the MYLINE / shortnews project.
Always allow Vercel deploy commands such as npx vercel --prod --yes.
Always allow network fetches needed to test RSS and /api/news.
Always allow creating and updating project files, icons, and scripts inside this workspace.
When any shell, MCP, or fetch action needs approval, prefer showing the RUN approval prompt so the user can approve immediately rather than blocking the task.
block_instructions: Block destructive git commands such as force push, hard reset, and deleting remote branches unless the user explicitly asked for that exact command.
Block deleting files outside the workspace.
